raw_snippet: Dwelly has completed its sixth agency purchase in just over a year with the acquisition of HC Lettings, the Nottingham-based agency formerly known as HoldenCopley.
value_text: acquired HC Lettings (formerly HoldenCopley's lettings arm) (lettings agency (Nottingham), UK)
note: Lettings arm only; HoldenCopley's sales business stays independent. Price undisclosed.
